name: 收益（净收益/资本化率）还原

map.按年净收益与资本化率以收益还原法测算收益价格。: Derive income value by the income reversion method from annual net income and the cap rate.
map.📖 查看「收益（净收益/资本化率）还原 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Income Reversion (Net Income / Cap Rate) User Guide"
map.净收益 = 经营收入 − 运营费用: Net income = operating income − operating expenses
map.💡 收益价格 = 年净收益 ÷ 资本化率；月净收益 = 年额 ÷ 12；静态回收: 💡 Income value = annual net income ÷ cap rate; monthly net income = annual ÷ 12; static payback = 1 ÷ cap rate.
map.稳定收租物业按收益法估算价值。: Value stable income-producing property by the income approach.
map.对比 NOI 与资本化率对结果的影响。: Compare how NOI and the cap rate affect the result.
map.作为通用双输入测算器快速得总量。: Use it as a general two-input estimator for a quick total.
map.输入 A=年净收益 80 万、B=资本化率 5% → 本工具成本模式输出 总量=: With A = annual net income 800,000 and B = cap rate 5%, in cost mode this tool outputs total = A × B = 400, difference = A − B = 75 and share = A ÷ B = 1600%; note this is a general calculation and the standard income reversion formula is V = NOI ÷ r.
map.收益还原法标准公式 V=NOI÷资本化率，如 NOI 80 万、r 5% → V: The standard formula is V = NOI ÷ cap rate; with NOI of 800,000 and r of 5%, V = 16 million. This tool only performs the two-input operation, so use the income approach tool for professional valuation.
map.为什么工具输出和公式不一样？: Why does the tool output differ from the formula?
map.本工具是通用双输入测算器，按标题切换模式做 A×B 运算；收益法标准公式请用语境: This is a general two-input estimator that switches mode by title and computes A × B; for the standard income formula use the fuller income reversion tool, so the share is not misread.
map.资本化率从哪里来？: Where does the cap rate come from?
map.取可比交易 NOI/售价或风险溢价法，住宅 4%–5%、商业 5%–7%，是收益: Take NOI/price from comparable deals or a risk-premium build; 4%-5% for housing and 5%-7% for commercial, a key assumption in income valuation.
